hook: France ended South Africa's 21-year streak with a 21-19 victory.

sections.voiceover: France ended South Africa's 21-year streak with a 21-19 victory.
b_roll: historic stadium photo of Stade de France under lights
scoreboard graphic displaying France 21 South Africa 19

sections.voiceover: At Stade de France in Saint-Denis, France built a 21-7 halftime lead. Captain Antoine Dupont teamed with Maxime Lucu after just one training session together. Where did the 19-point Springboks fall short?
b_roll: halftime score breakdown graphic showing 21 to 7
tactical diagram of half-back pairing Dupont and Lucu
bar chart of head-to-head records across 11 matches

sections.voiceover: France had only 2 wins across 11 meetings against South Africa.
b_roll: trend line graphic showing 2 wins in 11 meetings

sections.voiceover: The French squad held off world champion South Africa in Paris. France earned their second win across 11 stadium meetings. Dupont produced a standout individual performance as France secured a famous 21-19 win.
b_roll: flow diagram of French defensive positioning
match record chart highlighting 2nd historic win

sections.voiceover: That ended 21 years of Springbok domination at Stade de France.
b_roll: timeline graphic marking 21-year winless streak end
